title: Youth Slang, Street Register, and Subcultural Jargon
grammar: Youth slang, street register, and subcultural jargon (bevállal, kiakad, rákattan, átlát, duma)
goal: I can recognize common slang verbs with metaphorical preverbs, such as bevállal, kiakad and rákattan
I can understand these verbs when friends use them in casual conversation
I can tell which slang words to avoid in a formal text
